description: Department of Legal Affairs - Amendment to the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No. 43 of 2000 - Reserved by the Legal Affairs Dept. on 2018.12.31
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Finance and Mass Media under the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No. 43 of 2000. It specifically amends the Insurance Regulatory Commission Regulations, 2005 regarding annual fee payments. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and amendments to existing regulations.
